business_process: 911 emergency call intake and dispatch (county zone)
description: Receive county CAD-to-CAD incidents and transferred callers; triage; assign and track the closest unit
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Delayed ambulance response can contribute to death or disability; county agreement response-time standards; manual mode is safe for about 2 hours before unit tracking errors grow; CAD database point-in-time restore supports a 15-minute RPO
manual_workaround: Manual dispatch binder: paper incident cards, magnetic unit status board, county PSAP voice announcement on the P25 radio system; after 2 hours ask the county PSAP to route new calls to the mutual-aid provider
dependent_third_parties: County PSAP and county CAD; county P25 radio system; hosted phone vendor; cloud provider; ISPs

business_process: Interfacility and non-emergency transport scheduling and dispatch
description: Book trips from hospitals and nursing facilities; schedule crews; dispatch and track
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 70% of revenue (about $26,000 a day); delayed discharges and missed dialysis appointments; facilities switch to competitors after repeated delays
manual_workaround: Paper trip log; facilities call the dispatch cell phone; defer scheduled non-urgent trips
dependent_third_parties: Hospitals and nursing facilities; hosted phone vendor

business_process: Patient care documentation and hospital record delivery
description: Crews document care on ePCR tablets; records delivered to the receiving hospital
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Hospital must be able to get the patient care record on request within 48 hours of dispatch (Rule 64J-1.014, F.A.C.); verbal report at handoff covers immediate care; tablets store records offline
manual_workaround: Paper patient care record and abbreviated record in downtime kits; back-enter into ePCR after restoration

description: Mobile data to MDCs, AVL positions for unit recommendation, radio
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without AVL, dispatchers cannot pick the closest unit; radio is the life-safety channel and is county-operated; AVL history needed only for reports (daily backup)
manual_workaround: Crews report location and status by radio; county P25 radio in every ambulance
dependent_third_parties: County P25 radio system; cellular carriers

description: Import trip data; code service level and mileage; submit claims; post payments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow: about $260,000 billed per week; payers accept late claims within filing limits
manual_workaround: Queue trips; submit when restored; draw on line of credit

description: Receive and file physician certification statements and facility face sheets
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Medicare requires certification statements on file for non-emergency transports (42 CFR 410.40(e)); missing statements delay claims
manual_workaround: Facilities hand paper PCS to crews at pickup; scan later

business_process: Crew scheduling, payroll, and credential tracking
description: Shift schedules, time capture, payroll, EMT and paramedic certification expiry tracking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Printed 2-week schedule covers short outages; payroll runs biweekly; staffing an ambulance with an expired certification is a licensure issue
manual_workaround: Printed schedule; repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider; manual certification list

description: EMSTARS data submission; monthly county response-time reports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: State data can be submitted late with notice; county reports are monthly; data comes from CAD and ePCR backups
manual_workaround: Submit late with an explanation; rebuild reports from restored data
